title: Step 3 - Designing ANN: Sequential Model & Dense Layers for Deep Learning

cues.en: Instructor: Hello, my friends.
cues.zh: 各位朋友，大家好。

cues.en: Welcome to part two of this implementation where we're gonna build together the artificial neural network.
cues.zh: 歡迎進入實作第二部分，一起建立人工神經網路。

cues.en: I'm super excited to start.
cues.zh: 我非常期待開始。

cues.en: We will do it in four steps.
cues.zh: 總共分成四個步驟。

cues.en: In the first step, we will initialize the ANN as a sequence of layers, then we will add the input layer and the first hidden layer composed of a certain number of neurons,
cues.zh: 第一步，將 ANN 初始化為依序堆疊的層；接著加入輸入層與第一個隱藏層，隱藏層會包含一定數量的神經元，

cues.en: which we'll choose together, then we'll add the second hidden layer in order to build indeed a deep learning model as opposed to a shallow learning model.
cues.zh: 數量等一下決定；然後加入第二個隱藏層，讓它成為深度學習模型，而非淺層模型。

cues.en: And then finally, we will add the output layer which will contain what we want to predict.
cues.zh: 最後加入輸出層，包含要預測的結果。

cues.en: All right, let's do this.
cues.zh: 好，開始吧。

cues.en: We're gonna tackle these four steps in this one same tutorial.
cues.zh: 這四個步驟會在同一堂課完成。

cues.en: So let's do this, starting with this one initializing the ANN as a sequence of layers.
cues.zh: 先從將 ANN 初始化為層的序列開始。

cues.en: So let's create a new coat cell and now let me explain how we need to proceed.
cues.zh: 建立新的程式碼儲存格，先說明應該怎麼做。

cues.en: So the first thing we have to do is obviously to create a variable that will be nothing else than the artificial neural network itself.
cues.zh: 第一件事當然是建立一個變數，代表人工神經網路本身。

cues.en: And guess what?
cues.zh: 你猜怎麼建立？

cues.en: This artificial neural network variable will be created as an object of a certain class.
cues.zh: 它會是某個類別的物件。

cues.en: And that certain class is the sequential class which allows exactly to build an artificial neural network but as a sequence of layers as opposed to a computational graph.
cues.zh: 就是 Sequential 類別，讓我們把人工神經網路建立成依序堆疊的層，而不是另一種計算圖結構。

cues.en: You saw in the intuition lectures that an artificial neural network is actually a sequence of layers, starting from the input layer and then successively, we have the fully connected layers
cues.zh: 直覺課程提過，人工神經網路可以是一連串的層，從輸入層開始，依序通過各個全連接層，

cues.en: up to the final output layer.
cues.zh: 最後到輸出層。

cues.en: That's what I mean by a sequence of layers.
cues.zh: 這就是所謂層的序列。

cues.en: And then the other type of neural network is indeed a computational graph which are neurons connected anyway not in successive layers.
cues.zh: 另一種神經網路則採用計算圖，神經元以不同方式連接，而不是依次堆疊的層。

cues.en: And an example of this is Boltzmann machines.
cues.zh: 例如波茲曼機。

cues.en: Restricted Boltzmann machines or deep Boltzmann machines are great examples of computational graph.
cues.zh: 受限波茲曼機與深度波茲曼機，都是計算圖的好例子。

cues.en: Of course, they're not covered in this course because this is really advanced deep learning but they are covered in our deep learning A to Z course if you are really interested in deep learning
cues.zh: 本課沒有涵蓋，因為那是很進階的深度學習；不過 Deep Learning A-Z 有介紹。如果真的對深度學習有興趣，

cues.en: and want to go deeper into this branch, well, I'll be happy to welcome you into the deep learning A to Z course but now let's just get the right introduction to deep learning with only fully connected neural networks.
cues.zh: 想繼續深入這個分支，歡迎加入那門課。現在先用只有全連接層的神經網路，建立正確的入門基礎。

cues.en: And so that's why we will create our new variable which we're gonna call ANN and which will be nothing else than the artificial neural network we're gonna build
cues.zh: 因此，要建立一個叫 ann 的新變數，代表我們即將建構的人工神經網路。

cues.en: and we will create that variable as an object of the sequential class.
cues.zh: 並把它建立成 Sequential 類別的物件。

cues.en: Okay?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: But of course the sequential class is not taken from nowhere, it is actually taken from the models module from the Keras library
cues.zh: Sequential 當然不是憑空出現，而是來自 Keras 函式庫中的 models 模組，

cues.en: which since TensorFlow 2.0 belongs to TensorFlow.
cues.zh: 從 TensorFlow 2.0 起，Keras 就整合在 TensorFlow 裡。

cues.en: Before we had TensorFlow and Keras separated, but now since the new TensorFlow, the new version of TensorFlow 2.0 where Keras was integrated into TensorFlow
cues.zh: 以前 TensorFlow 和 Keras 是分開的，但 TensorFlow 2.0 將 Keras 整合進來。

cues.en: and therefore the way to call the sequential class here is to call first TensorFlow, which has a shortcut TF, from which we're gonna call the Keras library
cues.zh: 所以這裡要呼叫 Sequential，先從簡稱為 tf 的 TensorFlow，取得 keras，

cues.en: and from which we're gonna call the models module.
cues.zh: 再取得 models 模組。

cues.en: Perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: And from which we call indeed that sequential class.
cues.zh: 然後呼叫 Sequential 類別。

cues.en: And so that, all this creates this ANN variable which represents our artificial neural network created as an instance of that sequential class
cues.zh: 整個表達式會建立 ann 變數，它代表神經網路，是 Sequential 的實例，

cues.en: which initializes our artificial neural network as a sequence of layers.
cues.zh: 也就是將人工神經網路初始化成依序堆疊的層。

cues.en: And that's our first step.
cues.zh: 第一步就完成了。

cues.en: Congratulations. Now, you really made your step into how to build an artificial neural network.
cues.zh: 恭喜，現在真正踏進了建構人工神經網路的實作。

cues.en: So let's move on to the next step which is to add the input layer and the first hidden layer.
cues.zh: 下一步是加入輸入層和第一個隱藏層。

cues.en: And that's where we're gonna start using the famous dense class in TensorFlow, and even in pytorch which is another great library to build neural networks.
cues.zh: 這裡會開始使用 TensorFlow 裡著名的 Dense 類別；另外 PyTorch 也是很好的神經網路函式庫。

cues.en: The way to add a fully connected layer into an artificial neural network at whatever phase you are, whatever the state of your artificial neural network is,
cues.zh: 不管人工神經網路建構到什麼階段，要新增全連接層，

cues.en: well, is to use the dense class.
cues.zh: 就使用 Dense 類別。

cues.en: And the way we use it is very simply by taking our artificial neural network object, that instance of the sequential class, from which we're gonna call one of the methods
cues.zh: 使用方式很簡單，從神經網路物件，也就是 Sequential 實例，呼叫它的一個方法，

cues.en: of the sequential class, and that method is add.
cues.zh: 這個方法叫 add。

cues.en: We certainly hope that there is ad method inside a sequential class, so that's the method we need right now to add anything we want
cues.zh: Sequential 當然提供 add 方法，現在就用它新增需要的內容，

cues.en: whether it is a hidden layer or a dropout layer, which allows to prevent over fitting or we will see with convolution neural networks that we can also add, well a conv2D layer,
cues.zh: 不管是隱藏層、能協助避免過度擬合的 Dropout 層，或稍後卷積神經網路會用到的 Conv2D，

cues.en: which is a convolution layer.
cues.zh: 也就是卷積層。

cues.en: Well, we can add anything, but right now what we wanna add is a simple, fully connected layer.
cues.zh: 可以加入各種層，但現在要的是簡單的全連接層。

cues.en: And the way to add this is to enter in these parenthesis because add is a method.
cues.zh: add 是方法，所以在它的括號內傳入要新增的物件。

cues.en: Well, it is to add exactly that fully connected layer which will be a new object, it will be a new instance of a new class.
cues.zh: 也就是把全連接層建立成新物件，作為另一個類別的新實例。

cues.en: And that new class is of course the dense class.
cues.zh: 這個類別當然是 Dense。

cues.en: So the fully connected layer we're about to build will be created as an object of the dense class.
cues.zh: 即將建立的全連接層，會是 Dense 的物件。

cues.en: And therefore, now the only thing we have to do is to call that dense class.
cues.zh: 所以現在只要呼叫 Dense 類別。

cues.en: And this will create that fully connected layer object, and at the same time, it will automatically add the input layer.
cues.zh: 就能建立全連接層物件，同時自動加入輸入層。

cues.en: All right, so let's call that dense class.
cues.zh: 來呼叫 Dense。

cues.en: And once again, that dense class is not taken from nowhere.
cues.zh: 同樣地，Dense 也不是憑空出現。

cues.en: It belongs to a certain path of libraries.
cues.zh: 它隸屬於特定的函式庫路徑。

cues.en: And of course, the root of that library is our TensorFlow library.
cues.zh: 最上層當然是 TensorFlow。

cues.en: Then from which we're gonna call, once again, the Keras library, there we go, from which, this time we're not gonna call the models module,
cues.zh: 再取得 keras，但這次不是 models 模組，

cues.en: but actually this one, it's top of the list layers.
cues.zh: 而是清單最上面的 layers。

cues.en: That's exactly what we need to add here.
cues.zh: 這正是需要的模組。

cues.en: This is the module that contains the different tools, and by tools, I mean classes to add, well, any layer you want in your artificial neural network.
cues.zh: 它包含各種工具，也就是可用來加入不同神經網路層的類別。

cues.en: So layers here.
cues.zh: 所以使用 layers。

cues.en: And speaking of these classes, well, that's from this layers module that we're gonna call our dense class, which as any class can take several arguments.
cues.zh: 再從 layers 呼叫 Dense，和其他類別一樣，它可以接受多個引數。

cues.en: And here we have to indeed enter these arguments.
cues.zh: 這裡要填入相應參數。

cues.en: The most important one is this one, unit, which corresponds exactly to the number of neurons, to the number of hidden neurons you want to have in this first hidden layer,
cues.zh: 最重要的是 units，代表第一個隱藏層要放多少個隱藏神經元，

cues.en: not in the input layer.
cues.zh: 而不是輸入層的神經元數。

cues.en: We will automatically have our different features.
cues.zh: 輸入層會自動對應各個特徵。

cues.en: In the input layer, the input neurons will simply be all these features starting from credit score.
cues.zh: 輸入神經元就是從 CreditScore 開始的這些特徵。

cues.en: That will be one neuron, then another input neuron, then another one, up to this one.
cues.zh: 這個特徵對應一個神經元，再下一個，依此類推。

cues.en: All these will be the input neurons in the input layer.
cues.zh: 這些就是輸入層的神經元。

cues.en: But then when we create that first hidden layer we will have some hidden neurons inside.
cues.zh: 建立第一個隱藏層時，裡面也會有隱藏神經元。

cues.en: And in this dense function now, well, we can specify of course, how many hidden neurons we want to have.
cues.zh: 可以透過 Dense 指定想要的數量。

cues.en: And now, now comes the most frequently asked question in deep learning.
cues.zh: 接下來就是深度學習中最常被問到的問題。

cues.en: The very famous question, how do we know how many neurons we want?
cues.zh: 這個著名問題是：怎麼知道需要多少個神經元？

cues.en: Is there a rule of thumb, or should we just experiment?
cues.zh: 有經驗法則，還是只能實驗？

cues.en: Well, unfortunately, there is no rule of thumb.
cues.zh: 很可惜，沒有固定的經驗法則。

cues.en: It is just based on experimentation or we call it the work of an artist.
cues.zh: 必須透過實驗，也有人把這稱為藝術家的工作。

cues.en: You have to experiment with different hyper parameters.
cues.zh: 你得嘗試不同的超參數。

cues.en: We call them hyper parameters in the sense that these are parameters that won't be trained during the training process.
cues.zh: 之所以叫超參數，是因為這些值不會在訓練過程中被學習。

cues.en: So unfortunately, there is no rule of thumb and therefore we just have to pick one number here which wouldn't sound irrelevant or extravagant.
cues.zh: 所以沒有固定法則，只能先挑一個不至於太離譜的數字。

cues.en: And that number will be six.
cues.zh: 這次選 6。

cues.en: I actually tried several numbers, and I got more or less the same accuracy in the end.
cues.zh: 我實際試過幾個不同數量，最後的準確率都差不多。

cues.en: So it's all good.
cues.zh: 所以沒問題。

cues.en: You can try different ones if you want but six is totally fine.
cues.zh: 你也可以試其他值，但 6 已經很好。

cues.en: So here inside this dense class we will enter for our first parameter, which is unit, well, units equals six.
cues.zh: 因此在 Dense 的第一個參數填 units=6。

cues.en: Perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: All right, and now the next parameter that is important among this huge list of parameters you can see many of them, but no worries we will keep the default value for all of them, except this one
cues.zh: 下一個重要參數就在這個長清單裡。雖然參數很多，但不用擔心，其他全部保留預設值，只有這個例外，

cues.en: which corresponds of course, to the activation function.
cues.zh: 也就是激活函數。

cues.en: And you saw in the intuition lecturers if you will that the activation function in the hidden layers of a fully connected neural network must be the rectifier activation function.
cues.zh: 直覺課程提過，全連接神經網路的隱藏層要使用整流激活函數。

cues.en: And therefore, that's exactly what we must specify here.
cues.zh: 因此這裡要指定它。

cues.en: We of course, don't want no activation function.
cues.zh: 當然不希望完全沒有激活函數。

cues.en: So here we have to specify that we want rectify activation function.
cues.zh: 這裡指定使用整流激活函數。

cues.en: And the way to specify this is to enter here in our activation parameter, well, the code name for the rectifier activation function
cues.zh: 做法是在 activation 參數填入它的程式名稱，

cues.en: which is in quote, well ReLU.
cues.zh: 也就是引號裡的 relu。

cues.en: That's the code name for the rectifier activation function.
cues.zh: 這就是整流激活函數的代號。

cues.en: And that is all you have to enter here in order to make a fully working first fully connected hidden layer.
cues.zh: 只要填入這些，就能建立可運作的第一個全連接隱藏層。

cues.en: Congratulations.
cues.zh: 恭喜。

cues.en: Now, you know how to build, actually a shallow neural network.
cues.zh: 現在你已經知道如何建立淺層神經網路。

cues.en: And you will know in a second how to build a deep neural network.
cues.zh: 再過一下就會知道如何建立深度神經網路。

cues.en: Because the way to actually add a second hidden layer here couldn't be more simple.
cues.zh: 因為加入第二個隱藏層的做法，再簡單不過。

cues.en: The only thing that you have to do is just copy this line of code, and then in a new line of code here for the second hidden layer, you just need to paste it.
cues.zh: 只要複製這行程式碼，再貼到第二個隱藏層對應的新儲存格。

cues.en: That's what I mean by this add method can add any new layer at whatever stage of the construction process of your ANN you're into.
cues.zh: 這就是我說的，無論 ANN 建構到哪個階段，add 都能加入新的層。

cues.en: You can use this ad method to add anything, and the way to add a second hidden layer is just the same as adding the first hidden layer.
cues.zh: 可以用 add 新增各種內容，第二個隱藏層與第一個的加入方式一樣。

cues.en: Unless of course you want to change the number of hidden neurons, but six hidden neurons in the first hidden layer and six other ones in this second hidden layer is just fine.
cues.zh: 除非想改變神經元數量，但第一個隱藏層 6 個、第二個也 6 個，已經足夠。

cues.en: But once again, feel free to change the hyper parameter values here.
cues.zh: 當然，這些超參數都可以自行修改。

cues.en: Maybe you will get a better accuracy in the end.
cues.zh: 或許最後能得到更好的準確率。

cues.en: And if that's the case, well please share it in the comments or by private message.
cues.zh: 如果有，請在留言或私訊中分享。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: However, now to add the output layer you have to do something special, something different than what we did here.
cues.zh: 不過，加入輸出層需要做一些不同的設定。

cues.en: So let's do this together.
cues.zh: 我們一起完成。

cues.en: Let's create a new coat cell.
cues.zh: 建立新的程式碼儲存格。

cues.en: And well, let's actually paste what we just copied before once again here, but this time we'll have to change two things which correspond actually to the values of these two parameters.
cues.zh: 再貼上剛複製的程式碼，但這次要修改兩個地方，也就是兩個參數值。

cues.en: But first, let me explain why all the rest is the same.
cues.zh: 先說明為什麼其他部分相同。

cues.en: Well, that's of course, because we are adding a new layer and this add method can add any layer you want, including of course, the output layer.
cues.zh: 因為仍然是新增一層，而 add 能新增任何層，當然也包括輸出層。

cues.en: So here we're still using the add method to add this final output layer, and then of course we still want our output layer to be fully connected to that second hidden layer
cues.zh: 所以繼續用 add 新增最終輸出層，而且希望它與第二個隱藏層完全連接，

cues.en: and therefore we're using again here, the dense class.
cues.zh: 因此同樣使用 Dense。

cues.en: So all good here but then these two parameters have to be changed.
cues.zh: 這些都沒問題，但兩個參數必須修改。

cues.en: And if you follow the intuition lectures you should know what must be these two changes.
cues.zh: 如果有看直覺課程，你應該知道要改哪兩個。

cues.en: All right, so let's start with this one.
cues.zh: 先從這個開始。

cues.en: According to you, what do we need to replace here?
cues.zh: 你認為要替換什麼？

cues.en: Well, that's of course this value, but according to you six has to be replaced by which value?
cues.zh: 當然是這個數值，那 6 應該改成多少？

cues.en: Well, to get the answer, we need to have a look at our dependent variable again, which is this one.
cues.zh: 要回答，就再看一次應變數，也就是這一欄。

cues.en: Because remember, the output layer contains the dimensions of the output, the output you want to predict.
cues.zh: 記得，輸出層要對應想預測的輸出維度。

cues.en: And here, since we actually want to predict a binary variable, which can take the value one or zero while the dimension is actually one.
cues.zh: 這裡預測的是只能取 0 或 1 的二元變數，因此維度是 1。

cues.en: Because we only need one neuron to get that final prediction zero or one.
cues.zh: 因為只需要一個神經元，就能得到最終的 0 或 1 預測。

cues.en: However, if we were doing classification with a non-binary dependent variable like dependent variable that has three classes let's say ABC,
cues.zh: 但如果分類的應變數不是二元，例如有 A、B、C 三類，

cues.en: well, we would actually need three dimensions, three output neurons to once again one hunting code that dependent variable, because of course, once again there is no relationship order
cues.zh: 就需要三個維度、三個輸出神經元，對應變數進行獨熱編碼，因為

cues.en: between the classes A, B, and C.
cues.zh: A、B、C 類別之間同樣沒有順序關係。

cues.en: So A, for example, will have to be encoded by 100 then B will have to be encoded by 010 and C will have to be encoded by 001,
and therefore you need three neurons getting these value zero and one to encode your three classes, A, B, and C.
cues.zh: 因此需要三個神經元，各輸出 0 或 1，表示 A、B、C 三類。

cues.en: But here, since we actually have binary variable a binary outcome, well you only need one neuron to encode these outcomes into one or zero.
cues.zh: 但現在是二元變數、二元結果，只需要一個神經元表示 1 或 0。

cues.en: And therefore, the value of that unit parameter here that we have to replace right now is actually one.
cues.zh: 所以這裡 units 要改成 1。

cues.en: Okay?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: One output neuron encoding the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 用一個輸出神經元表示應變數。

cues.en: And then second change correspond, of course, to that activation function and more specifically to the value of the activation function.
cues.zh: 第二個修改，當然是激活函數的值。

cues.en: Well, once again, remember in the intuition lectures that for the activation function of the output layer, well you don't want to have a rectifier activation function
cues.zh: 記得直覺課程提過，輸出層不要使用整流激活函數，

cues.en: but a sigmoid activation function.
cues.zh: 而是使用 sigmoid。

cues.en: Why is that?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: It's because having a sigmoid activation function allows to get not only ultimately the predictions but even better, it'll give you the probabilities
cues.zh: 因為 sigmoid 不只能給出最終預測，更能提供

cues.en: that the binary outcome is one, so that we will not only get the predictions of whether the customers choose to leave or not the bank
